verdict.rationale: Canva's own docs describe design export in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) through its MCP server, so the core export capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows SVG export or per-layer export controls. Design-level resizing is not the same as per-asset export scales, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: SVG export evidence, per-layer/element export presets, export scale multipliers, slices, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices

citations.quote: Design export:** Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on)
